faq.a: nearQ’s itch.io listing supplies the downloadable clients, and the developer describes the game as free. Take the files only from the developer’s listing, since similarly named projects exist.

faq.q: Can I play Midgard Survivors in a browser?
faq.a: No browser version was found. The developer’s launch replies say browser play is unavailable, and a browser result with a similar name may be a different project.

faq.q: Should I install the Vulkan or the OpenGL Android APK?
faq.a: Start with the Vulkan APK, the developer’s default. If it closes immediately or stays black, the developer offers an OpenGL APK for affected phones, including some Xiaomi and Mali devices.

faq.q: Why does the Mac build say the app is damaged?
faq.a: The developer recommends installing the Mac alpha through the itch.io app. For a browser-downloaded copy, the developer documents one Terminal command to clear quarantine attributes after moving the app to Applications.

faq.q: How do I equip different armor between runs?
faq.a: After a completed run, choose the items offered to keep, return to character selection and open Gear at the bottom. That route comes from a player reply and may vary with your build.

faq.q: Can I play Midgard Survivors with friends?
faq.a: The developer advertises online co-op for up to four players. Open a room and share its code, or use a party invitation in Prontera.
